in_marathi.name: Atikur
in_marathi.long_meaning: Atikur हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Atikur is derived from Sanskrit roots, 'ati' meaning ancient or beyond, and 'kur' meaning ruler or guardian. This name symbolizes one who is ancient, timeless, and a guardian or ruler.
